gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 was $739.045m. During 2024 there was a net favourable movement in prior year estimates resulting in a gross release of approximately $59.134m ( -8.0% of opening gross reserves), driven primarily by favourable claims development and reinsurance recoveries. This favourable prior-year movement is reflected in claims incurred (net favourable prior-year movement of $35.7m noted). Offsetting current year deterioration was an exceptionally active 2024 hurricane season (including named hurricanes Milton and Helene) which contributed to a higher net claims ratio for the year.

The collection of losses in 2023 of $39.0m relates to the 2020 and prior years of account for SGL No. 1 Limited. These years of account were transferred through Reinsurance to Close ("RITC") to Syndicate 2008 on 1 January 2023.
